title: Marcus Erickson's AI Builds
intro: Claude skills and Chrome extensions I have built. Each one lives in its own public repository, with a README that explains what it does and how to use it.

items.name: Contract Review Skill
items.description: Runs five fixed review prompts against a construction contract and shows the full contract beside the results, with every point linking to the clause it cites. In Claude, an Ask Claude tab answers your own questions.

items.name: Submittal Register Skill
items.description: Three skills for submittals: build a register from a project manual or spec PDF, compare two registers, and keep one current from transmittals and stamped returns.

items.name: BIM Viewer Skill
items.description: A browser tool that shows what is inside Revit files, IFC files and classified point-cloud scans, with an Ask Claude chat when it runs inside Claude. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.

items.name: AI Usage Tracker
items.description: Shows how much of your Claude, ChatGPT, Grok and Gemini plan you have used and predicts whether you will hit the limit before it resets.

items.name: AI Command Deck
items.description: Replaces the new tab page with a launchpad of AI tools, so opening a tab starts with the question "What will you build today?"

items.name: React Project Checkup Toolkit
items.description: Audit checklists and AI prompts that find what vibe-coded React and React Native apps usually miss, such as exposed API keys, missing error handling, accessibility gaps and App Store requirements, with the exact prompts to fix each one. There is a free 10-check Quick Audit and a paid Deep Audit with 150+ checks.
